title: FIDO2 on Linux can do more than web logins: securing sudo, su and system login with pam-u2f
content_md:
FIDO2 on Linux can do more than web logins. With pam-u2f, a FIDO2 security key can be used directly for Linux authentication.

via Mastodon https://www.tuxedocomputers.com/de/Nitrokey-FIDO2-fuer-sudo-su-und-den-Linux-Login-einrichten.tuxedo
